title: Release/acquire visibility abstraction
contract: When a read observes the stipulated release/acquire synchronization edge, it must observe the initialized payload.
scope: Boolean synchronization edge and stale-read choice; admitted edge present; axiomatic toy model, not full hardware memory semantics.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: Observed payload respects stipulated visibility constraint.
Returned payload is initialized value one.

variants.description: Permit stale read even with synchronization.
Select the published value by explicit edge case analysis.
